description: A source file implementing an FX interpreter and transformer classes for Torch FX. It includes classes for interpreting FX graphs node-by-node, as well as transforming FX graphs to produce new modules. The file contains methods for executing different types of nodes, managing environment states, and generating human-readable representations for debugging.

classes.name: Interpreter
classes.description: Executes an FX graph node-by-node, allowing customization of execution behavior through method overriding.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Subclasses Interpreter to produce a new transformed FX module without executing the original.
